english.notes:
(i) This offence should only be used where the conspiracy is to commit offences against the state outside England and Wales.
(ii) Section 1A of the Criminal Law Act 1977 provides conditions in relation to this offence.
(iii) Section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977 provides the offence of conspiracy. The ingredients of the statutory offence of conspiracy were set out at length in R v Saik 2006.
(iv) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, see section 4(5) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
(v) MoPI Group 2 has been allocated to ensure manual review. The MoPI group of the substantive offence applies.
